items.title: Parabola
paragraphs: The equation is unchanged by y→−y: it is symmetric about the x-axis. Both axes meet it only at the origin.
The lowest-degree term is 4ax, so the tangent at the origin is x=0. Real y requires x≥0. There are no finite straight-line asymptotes.
The upper branch increases and the lower branch decreases as x increases. The curve occupies the first and fourth quadrants.
items.final_answer: A right-opening parabola with vertex (0,0), tangent x=0 and x-axis symmetry.
